how have ice scraper designs evolved over time ice scrapers have come a long way from the basic tools your parents used to chip ice off their windshields what started as simple metal blades has turned into smart ergonomic tools that make winter mornings way less painful the early days back in the day people used whatever they could find coins credit cards or basic metal scrapers these early ice scrapers were just flat pieces of metal or plastic with sharp edges they worked but they were rough on your windshield and even rougher on your hands during those freezing mornings better materials and comfort as cars became more common companies started making ice scrapers specifically for vehicles they added foam grips and rubber handles so you wouldnt freeze your fingers off the blades got better too softer plastics that wouldnt scratch your windshield but still tough enough to break through thick ice multifunction tools modern ice scrapers do way more than just scrape youll find tools that combine ice breaking snow brushing and even squeegee functions all in one some have telescoping handles so you can reach across big suv windshields without stretching smart design features todays ice scrapers have angled blades that work with your natural hand motion many have different edge types serrated edges for thick ice and smooth edges for light frost the handles are designed to give you better leverage so you dont have to work as hard heated and electric options the newest ice scrapers can actually heat up to melt ice as you scrape these plug into your cars power outlet and make the job incredibly easy no more struggling with stubborn ice patches that just wont budge what to look for when youre shopping for a new ice scraper think about your specific needs do you live somewhere with heavy ice look for tools with icebreaking teeth got a big vehicle youll want an extendable handle for everyday use a good multifunction scraper with a comfortable grip works great the evolution of ice scraper design shows how even simple tools can get major improvements if youre tired of fighting with an old basic scraper you can check out some of the latest designs here to see what modern options are available why design matters better ice scraper design isnt just about convenience its about safety too scrapers that work faster and more effectively mean you spend less time outside in dangerous weather plus tools that dont damage your windshield save you money on repairs the next time winter hits and youre dreading that morning ice removal routine remember that you dont have to suffer with an outdated tool modern ice scrapers make the job faster easier and less frustrating than ever before you can explore current options to find something that fits your needs and budget from basic metal blades to heated ergonomic tools ice scraper evolution proves that good design can make even the most annoying winter chores manageable

battery glossary i thought it might be useful to create an a to z battery glossary based on the work of batterydesignnet and make it a free pdf it is early days and we are up to version 095 but i think it is already useful and hence have made it available to all a glimpse below of the first few terms 12v battery traditionally the 12v battery has been the electrical energy storage device used in passenger vehicles the most common chemistry has been lead acid however as of 2020 we are seeing a move towards lithium iron phosphate 18650 cylindrical cell format where the diameter of the cell is 18mm and the height of the cell is 65mm 21700 cylindrical cell format where the diameter of the cell is 21mm and the height of the cell is 70mm 24v battery the 24v battery packs tend to be used in commercial vehicles for starting and vehicle operation in passenger cars the 12v battery performs the same functions 12v nominal as the peak power demands are lower than those in large commercial vehicles 3rd electrode electrode added to a battery cell so that the anode and cathode potentials can be referenced against a known point 3d electrodes another way to increase energy density is with 3d electrodes increasing the surface area and connection to the active materials can improve a number of features of the cell 400v architecture can mean many things as claims are often made based on the maximum system voltage rather than the nominal battery pack voltage 46xx cylindrical cells an abbreviation for the new class of 46mm diameter cells at the moment it is based on the online glossaries that we have pulled together but over time the intention is to update and improve this document that is based on whether it would be useful

reviewing every death battle ever part 62 joker vs sweet tooth part 62 joker vs sweet tooth ugh clowns some people love them a lot of people hate them but personally in the context of this death battle they work pretty damn well joker vs sweet tooth is a matchup thats permanently ingrained into my memoryand ill let you decide whether thats a good thing or a bad thing lets dive right in we start with the joker the bane of gothams existencewell except for the actual bane of course man i love the joker im probably in the minority when i say i cant get enough of him in basically any media he appears in i liked him in mortal kombat i liked him in injustice i even liked his solo movie jared leto though yeah not so much the jokers analysis does a great job capturing why the character works so well he has countless iterations and conflicting origin stories some of which might be true and others completely fabricatedand that ambiguity is the whole point hes a walking mystery the only semiconsistent detail is that one bad day where he fell into a vat of chemicals bleaching his skin and turning his hair green from there they highlight what really makes joker dangerous his arsenal of absurd yet lethal tricks razorsharp playing cards machine guns explosive toys a lethal hand buzzer acidspraying flowers and of course the infamous joker venom which kills its victims by forcing them to laugh uncontrollably until they suffocate with that horrifying grin they also bring up the joker mobilespecifically the arkham versionwhich technically only appeared in a fever dream but honestly its believable enough joker has built absurd vehicles in other continuities so im willing to let that slide what really sells joker though is his mind outsmarting batman is impressive enough but hes even manipulated superman before which is just insane still despite his durabilitysurviving stabbings disfigurement and other grotesque injurieshes ultimately human he can die to very human things and that balance is what makes him compelling the end clip of him laughing uncontrollably is just the perfect cherry on top then we move on to sweet tooth and honestly the twisted metal world is just chaos incarnate one wish granted at the cost of participating in a brutal death race filled with guns rockets and blood sure why not and at the center of all that madness is one of gamings most infamous clowns sweet toothalso known as needles kanewas a psychopath long before the tournament an ice cream man with a twisted mind yes the irony is intentional he was eventually exposed as a serial killer who slaughtered indiscriminately even murdering his own family the guy was eventually caught after killing over a thousand people and sentenced to death only to survive the electric chair and be cursed with literal hellfire for a head that alone is insane then theres his vehiclealso named sweet toothwhich is basically a rolling apocalypse bombs spikes missiles absurd durability and the ability to transform into a fullon mech why can it do that who knows but it rules sweet tooth himself is absurdly hard to kill surviving things that should absolutely end a normal human that said hes also easily manipulated and that flaw has been his downfall more than once the analysis ends with a gruesome clip of him scooping someones eyes out capped off by boomstick delivering a perfectly fitting fucking clowns line beautiful now onto the fight itself and honestly the setup is fantastic joker laughing as he steals the batmobile and customizes it for himself is already peak joker energy he eventually runs into sweet tooth while hes making ice cream joker stealing the ice cream is such a stupid petty meaningless actand thats exactly why it works its completely in character and a perfect catalyst for chaos the voice acting here is strong gianni matragrano does a solid job as sweet toothnot mindblowing but effective lucas schuneman as joker though absolutely nails it he sounds incredible the battle quickly devolves into gunfire explosions and vehicular carnage and weirdly enough this fight has a better sense of speed and chaos than flash vs quicksilver make of that what you will joker fascinated by all the buttons in his new ride starts pressing everything at once launching missiles in every direction total anarchy sweet tooth eventually shoots joker out of the air sending him crashing hard even injured joker just laughs it off when he stands in front of sweet tooths car daring him to hit him its a clear dark knight reference and the timing of joker jumping into the vehicle at the last second is beautifully done the ensuing struggle inside the car is frantic and fun though i do have one nitpick joker sprays sweet tooth with acid and while it clearly hurts him theres no visible damage no blood nothing the mask explanation only goes so far but whatever things escalate when sweet tooth transforms into his mech form and absolutely wrecks joker punching him through a building and leaving him impaled on a crowbar and this is where the fight truly shines joker shifts gearsfrom goofy to terrifying his monologue here is incredible calm calculated and deeply unsettling he manipulates sweet tooth psychologically convincing him to leave the safety of his vehicle and when sweet tooth finally has joker in his grasp ready to kill him joker delivers the ultimate punchline joker venom the kill is phenomenal sweet tooth laughing uncontrollably as reality distorts around him the music turning sinister the laughter growing louder and more desperate until he finally suffocatesits haunting fitting and one of my favorite kills in the series i dont know if it cracks my top ten but its damn close this is honestly the only way this fight should have ended the conclusion wraps it up nicely stating that while joker wasnt stronger or faster his manipulation intimidation and sheer psychological dominance allowed him to outlast sweet tooth that feels completely right joker has taken down the justice league beforecharacters far smarter than sweet toothso this outcome tracks perfectly i dont really care what the general consensus on this episode is ive always loved joker vs sweet tooth and honestly i love it more every time i revisit it for me this is an easy 91100

ecosystem to extract refine and process it economically rare earths despite their name exist in concentrations across the globe but their refining requires complex environmentally intensive processes that the west systematically offshored gallium represents this problem in an even more acute form the speakers emphasis that this has been an ongoing problem for over two years contextualizes the that gallium is one of the most critical metals in global production today a claim that demands scrutiny unlike rare earths which have broader applications across multiple industries galliums criticality stems from its absolute indispensability in specific nonsubstitutable applications that underpin modern digital infrastructure and military systems the presenter positions gallium not merely as another entry on a growing list of critical minerals but as the preeminent strategic chokepointmore significant than rare earths because of the sheer impossibility of rapid substitution and 01110206 the video meticulously documents the evolution of chinas export control regime which occurred in two distinct phases that reveal a sophisticated understanding of leverage points in the global supply chain the initial 2023 measures appear almost modest on the surfacemerely requiring export licenses and restricting shipments however this characterization downplays the strategic genius of this approach by shifting from free market supply to a permissionbased system china transformed gallium from a commodity into a diplomatic instrument without triggering the international legal mechanisms that a formal embargo would activate the licensing requirement creates a nontransparent arbitrary decisionmaking process where chinese authorities can grant or deny permissions based on political considerations while maintaining plausible deniability this is far more flexible than a blanket ban because it allows china to reward compliant nations while punishing adversaries creating a divideandconquer dynamic among western allies the 2025 expansion demonstrates chinas recognition that controlling the raw material alone is insufficient for lasting leverage by adding specialized gallium extraction technologies such as resins and ion exchange methods to the restricted list china targeted the entire industrial knowledge ecosystem this is the crucial insight that separates gallium from other critical minerals even if western nations successfully rebuilt alumina refining capacity the primary source of gallium as a byproduct they would still lack access to the efficient costeffective separation technologies required to extract the gallium economically the presenter emphasizes that this means access to economically viable production methods would remain unavailable which is the videos core argument about the depth of chinas control this isnt merely about who owns the mines its about who owns the scientific processes the engineering expertise and the proprietary methods that make extraction commercially feasible the twoyear gap between the measures suggests a deliberate phased strategyfirst test the waters with raw material controls assess western responses database of texas energy plans without bill credits and other gimmicky terms this is best viewed on a desktop texas electricity plans as many texans know is the best place to search for an electricity plan in texas deregulated energy marketplace unfortunately not all plans on power to choose are equal and often times the electricity plans offered are intentionally deceptive long story short electricity providers intentionally try and lock texans in overpriced electricity plans i scraped the power to choose api to build a database of electricity plans available on power to choose that met the following criteria removed variable rate plans removed plans that include bill credits based on minimum usage thresholds removed prepaid plans removed timeofuse rate plans removed plans that require a smart thermostat for the advertised rate removed plans that require an electric vehicle for the advertised rate removed plans that required an initial carbon offset fee such as this one i have a script that will scrape the power to choose database daily so this database is always up to date the database can be filtered by the tdu that services your area aep oncor etc and by term you can also enter your projected kwh usage and view the projected cost of each plan by month i hope this tool helps and as a reddit community we can help folks avoid predatory electricity plans always open to suggestions on how this could be better too

replacing the global monetary system looking for likeminded people on rmoney id like to see if there are folks out there with an interest in replacing the global monetary system i know such a goal seems too far fetched but if nothing else you can treat it as an exercise in world building its ok if you dont think any of the ideas will ever become a reality if you find the ideas i propose below compelling please comment id love to discuss things in deeper detail utility and optionality id like to start this post by highlighting a hypothesis i hold near and dear to my heart influencing my whole world view of economics and investment i firmly believe that an investment only makes sense when you have the option to derive value from the asset itself you can if you so desire choose to sell it to someone else for a capital gain with the expectation that the new buyer will derive value from it but doing so is not required what do i mean by derive value i mean utility i mean concretely useful features of the asset that allow you to gain in some meaningful way without selling the most basic form of this is debt you buy a treasury bond from the us government for x you receive payments of y for a given term and then you receive your x back at the end at no point did you have to sell the treasury to someone else you derived value from it simply by being the owner a more complex form of this notion is land you purchase land and if you want you can sit on it and eventually sell it to someone else or you can build a house on it to live in or you can rent it to a farmer for growing crops or you can huntcamp on it for recreation etc etc owning land can be a good investment without selling it because it is a concretely useful asset from which utility is derived by the current owner the same can be said of buying electronics like a phone or computer buying food buying a table and chairs buying a car etc now sometimes these things receive wear and tear in their use and so you have to balance utility derived with the potential of capital loss due to depreciation but i think you get the point land and debt are easier to understand because they much more commonly result in capital gain but the principal holds even for consumer goods this is why i firmly believe most forms of equity especially public stocks with no dividend and no voting rights are a fundamentally unsound investment vehicle in order for you to derive value from equity you must sell it to someone else for a capital gain you have no optionality it has no inherent utility buying it and selling it are the only real traits in theory this means there should be just as much downward price pressure as upwards price pressure causing them to be stagnant in price but instead due to myriad incentive structures in place primarily from public policy they continue to vacuum up more and more of the cash in the economy and thus the self fulfilling prophecy of linegoesup continues to work yes you read correctly i find stocks to be a stupid idea if ive lost you already thats fine theres probably no reason for you to continue reading this post as i said initially this is a hypothesis i hold dearly it is not a fact it is not even a theory its just my opinion petrocurrency now that ive filtered readers for those that better align with my opinions id like to propose a new type of money commoditybacked currencies are often dismissed as too restrictive or inflexible after all we were previously on the gold standard it failed and thats that one could argue but i find theres a meaningful difference between a currency backed by speculative value precious metals and currency backed by automated labor energy precious metals have vanishingly little utility and it is not at all commensurate with the price sure the james webb space telescope used gold for the reflective surface to focus infrared waves to a point and sure people like shiny jewelry and other things that can be made out of gold but ultimately the price is completely out of wack with these use cases its driven primarily by speculation just like stocks and that means i find it to be an unsound investment vehicle instead i think a much more sound investment vehicle and thus a much more sound commodity with which to back a currency is energy energy is effectively fungible labor if you buy energy sure you can sell it to someone else for a capital gain if you so desire but more often youre going to use it yourself be that to operate a factory at the large scale or wash your clothes at the small scale energy is concretely useful because automated labor is concretely useful but energybacked currencies socalled metabolic currencies have been discussed quite often many economists dismiss them as well in particular they dismiss the idea of the kwhbased unit of account the reason this fails is because not all kwhs are the same it would be nice if electricity in location a was of equal value to electricity in location b but thats just not the case you cannot easily relocate electricity from one place to another preventing price disparities from normalizing this means it isnt fungible and thus it fails on one of the most basic requirements of a currency instead i firmly believe we should use petroleum to back a currency petroleum is relocatable you can ship it from one country to another without losing any of it in the process you dont need to run massive cables from every possible city to every other possible city you just use normal supply chains and yes there are differences in the various types of crude oil such as sulfur content but in general it does a good enough job of being fungible that we treat it as such already via the global price per barrel the other reason i find petrocurrency to be compelling is market size there are other types of metabolic currencies such as wheatbacked and ricebacked money these are very much energybased because food is energy for animals and humans but the size of the market is not commensurate with the size of the monetary system we need a commodity that roughly tracks the economy overall and food unfortunately only tracks the number of humans alive it does not scale with the amount of automated labor demand oil on the other hand can be burned to make electricity can be burned to propel a car forward can be chemically reconfigured to manufacture various forms of plastic and myriad other uses truly it is oil that can rise to the size of the economy in a way that food and precious metals cannot are you still with me biofuel now we need to take it a step further if we agree that a petrocurrency makes sense we need to think about scale and global reach sure we should also think about ecology and climate change but this is about economics not altruism so lets set those aside for now and think purely about the mechanics of a petrocurrency if crude oil from the ground operates at a scale commensurate with the size of the economy think about what a truly costcompetitive biofuel would unlock and im not talking biodiesel im not talking ethanol im talking renewable nalkanes farmed and manufactured in the hereandnow at a price cheaper than traditional drilling how we get there is still an unsolved problem i know its actually something i intend to research myself im going to go to grad school for chemical and biomolecular engineering so i can better understand the challenges of producing alkanes from cyanobacteria in the hopes of solving the unit economics of a real crude oil replacement but assuming for just a second that the unit economics of biofuel are solvable think about the implications of that trust think about the implications of an unbounded supply of oil the price could be sent to the floor and still be profitable under the right conditions and more importantly we could choose to manufacture exactly as much as we need to back the entire worlds currency supply onetoone we would not need a fractional reserve system like the gold standard ended up being there would never be a concern about a run on the currency because at any point in time literally anyone could redeem their money oil certificates for actual oil and make concrete use of that oil by filling up their car powering their house or any other energyconsuming use they dont have to sell the oil just to get utility out of it in order to replace the monetary system it needs to be trustworthy and a global wealth custodian responsible for storing this oil for backing the currency would inherently be more trustworthy than a government with ulterior motives the business responsible for this currency would be existentially tied to trust and it is specifically an unbounded supply of oil a fungible energy source that could instill that necessary trust in the global population by giving them both a reason to believe the money has value and a reason to not worry about redeeming it for that underlying value unnecessarily other topics i could talk about how inflation works in this system how to roll it out to the world by acquiring verifone how banking and transactions become cheaper than ever how insurance and other risktaking activities become a commodity with a single pool of customers and a single pool of market makers and so so so much more but i think for now ill leave it at that again if you find what i say compelling please get in touch i would love to have someone to discuss this with on a more regular basis

are there wireless ice scraper options winter mornings can be brutal when youre standing outside scraping ice off your windshield youve probably wondered if theres a better way to handle this tedious task the good news is that wireless ice scraper technology has come a long way in recent years what are wireless ice scrapers wireless ice scrapers are batterypowered tools that help remove ice and snow from your car windows without needing to plug into your vehicle these devices typically use heated elements or rotating mechanisms to break down ice formations more efficiently than traditional manual scrapers types of wireless options available most wireless ice removal tools fall into two categories heated scrapers and electric rotating scrapers heated models warm up the scraping surface to melt ice on contact while rotating versions use spinning discs or brushes to chip away frozen buildup battery life varies significantly between models some last 1520 minutes per charge while others goal seems too far fetched but if nothing else you can treat it as an exercise in world building its ok if you dont think any of the ideas will ever become a reality if you find the ideas i propose below compelling please comment or send a dm id love to discuss things in deeper detail utility and optionality id like to start this post by highlighting a hypothesis i hold near and dear to my heart influencing my whole world view of economics and investment i firmly believe that an investment only makes sense when you have the option to derive value from the asset itself you can if you so desire choose to sell it to someone else for a capital gain with the expectation that the new buyer will derive value from it but doing so is not required what do i mean by derive value i mean utility i mean concretely useful features of the asset that allow you to gain in some meaningful way without selling the most basic form of this is debt you buy a treasury bond from the us government for x you receive payments of y for a given term and then you receive your x back at the end at no point did you have to sell the treasury to someone else you derived value from it simply by being the owner a more complex form of this notion is land you purchase land and if you want you can sit on it and eventually sell it to someone else or you can build a house on it to live in or you can rent it to a farmer for growing crops or you can huntcamp on it for recreation etc etc owning land can be a good investment without selling it because it is a concretely useful asset from which utility is derived by the current owner the same can be said of buying electronics like a phone or computer buying food buying a table and chairs buying a car etc now sometimes these things receive wear and tear in their use and so you have to balance utility derived with the potential of capital loss due to depreciation but i think you get the point land and debt are easier to understand because they much more commonly result in capital gain but the principal holds even for consumer goods this is why i firmly believe most forms of equity especially public stocks with no dividend and no voting rights are a fundamentally unsound investment vehicle in order for you to derive value from equity you must sell it to someone else for a capital gain you have no optionality it has no inherent utility buying it and selling it are the only real traits in theory this means there should be just as much downward price pressure as upwards price pressure causing them to be stagnant in price but instead due to myriad incentive structures in place primarily from public policy they continue to vacuum up more and more of the cash in the economy and thus the self fulfilling prophecy of linegoesup continues to work yes you read correctly i find stocks to be a stupid idea if ive lost you already thats fine theres probably no reason for you to continue reading this post as i said initially this is a hypothesis i hold dearly it is not a fact it is not even a theory its just my opinion petrocurrency now that ive filtered readers for those that better align with my opinions id like to propose a new type of money commoditybacked currencies are often dismissed as too restrictive or inflexible after all we were previously on the gold standard it failed and thats that one could argue but i find theres a meaningful difference between a currency backed by speculative value precious metals and currency backed by automated labor energy precious metals have vanishingly little utility and it is not at all commensurate with the price sure the james webb space telescope used gold for the reflective surface to focus infrared waves to a point and sure people like shiny jewelry and other things that can be made out of gold but ultimately the price is completely out of wack with these use cases its driven primarily by speculation just like stocks and that means i find it to be an unsound investment vehicle instead i think a much more sound investment vehicle and thus a much more sound commodity with which to back a currency is energy energy is effectively fungible labor if you buy energy sure you can sell it to someone else for a capital gain if you so desire but more often youre going to use it yourself be that to operate a factory at the large scale or wash your clothes at the small scale energy is concretely useful because automated labor is concretely useful but energybacked currencies socalled metabolic currencies have been discussed quite often many economists dismiss them as well in particular they dismiss the idea of the kwhbased unit of account the reason this fails is because not all kwhs are the same it would be nice if electricity in location a was of equal value to electricity in location b but thats just not the case you cannot easily relocate electricity from one place to another preventing price disparities from normalizing this means it isnt fungible and thus it fails on one of the most basic requirements of a currency instead i firmly believe we should use petroleum to back a currency petroleum is relocatable you can ship it from one country to another without losing any of it in the process you dont need to run massive cables from every possible city to every other possible city you just use normal supply chains and yes there are differences in the various types of crude oil such as sulfur content but in general it does a good enough job of being fungible that we treat it as such already via the global price per barrel the other reason i find petrocurrency to be compelling is market size there are other types of metabolic currencies such as wheatbacked and ricebacked money these are very much energybased because food is energy for animals and humans but the size of the market is not commensurate with the size of the monetary system we need a commodity that roughly tracks the economy overall and food unfortunately only tracks the number of humans alive it does not scale with the amount of automated labor demand oil on the other hand can be burned to make electricity can be burned to propel a car forward can be chemically reconfigured to manufacture various forms of plastic and myriad other uses truly it is oil that can rise to the size of the economy in a way that food and precious metals cannot are you still with me biofuel now we need to take it a step further if we agree that a petrocurrency makes sense we need to think about scale and global reach sure we should also think about ecology and climate change but this is about economics not altruism so lets set those aside for now and think purely about the mechanics of a petrocurrency if crude oil from the ground operates at a scale commensurate with the size of the economy think about what a truly costcompetitive biofuel would unlock and im not talking biodiesel im not talking ethanol im talking renewable nalkanes farmed and manufactured in the hereandnow at a price cheaper than traditional drilling how we get there is still an unsolved problem i know its actually something i intend to research myself im going to go to grad school for chemical and biomolecular engineering so i can better understand the challenges of producing alkanes from cyanobacteria in the hopes of solving the unit economics of a real crude oil replacement but assuming for just a second that the unit economics of biofuel are solvable think about the implications of that trust think about the implications of an unbounded supply of oil the price could be sent to the floor and still be profitable under the right conditions and more importantly we could choose to manufacture exactly as much as we need to back the entire worlds currency supply onetoone we would not need a fractional reserve system like the gold standard ended up being there would never be a concern about a run on the currency because at any point in time literally anyone could redeem their money oil certificates for actual oil and make concrete use of that oil by filling up their car powering their house or any other energyconsuming use they dont have to sell the oil just to get utility out of it in order to replace the monetary system it needs to be trustworthy and a global wealth custodian responsible for storing this oil for backing the currency would inherently be more trustworthy than a government with ulterior motives the business responsible for this currency would be existentially tied to trust and it is specifically an unbounded supply of oil a fungible energy source that could instill that necessary trust in the global population by giving them both a reason to believe the money has value and a reason to not worry about redeeming it for that underlying value unnecessarily other topics i could talk about how inflation works in this system how to roll it out to the world by acquiring verifone how banking and transactions become cheaper than ever how insurance and other risktaking activities become a commodity with a single pool of customers and a single pool of market makers and so so so much more but i think for now ill leave it at that again if you find what i say compelling please get in touch i would love to have someone to discuss this with on a more regular basis
